text.en: This Order may be cited as the Customs (Amendment) (No. 2) Order, 2013. of section 152 of S 39/2006.

Section 152 of the Customs Order, 2006 is amended, in subsection (2J(i), by deleting", other than warehouse licences". Made this 8th. day of Sya'aban, 1434 Hijriah corresponding to the 17th. day of June, 2013 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
